kept.excerpt: Six candidates are running in the Democratic primary for Minnesota's 2nd Congressional District on Aug. 11, 2026. Kaela Berg (D), Matt Klein (D), and Matt Little (D) lead in endorsements, fundraising, and media attention. Incumbent Rep. Angie Craig (D) is running for the U.S. Senate rather than for another term.
kept.relevance: Establishes the primary date, open-seat context, and the three leading candidates within a six-candidate field.

kept.excerpt: MN-02 (D): GQR for Matt Klein: Matt Little: 26, Matt Klein: 19, Kaela Berg: 16, undecided: 39.
kept.publisher: The Downballot — David Nir and Jeff Singer
kept.relevance: A dated report of a rival-sponsored primary poll shows Little leading while a substantial share of voters remained undecided.

kept.excerpt: On June 8, 2026, the Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State announced the certification of candidates for all federal and state offices for the August 11, 2026 State Primary Election. Voting in the August 11 Primary Election will begin on June 26, 2026. Minnesotans can vote early in person at their local election office during business hours between June 26 and August 10.
kept.publisher: Office of the Minnesota Secretary of State
kept.relevance: Official election-administration guidance confirms the nomination timetable and that early voting was available before the evidence cutoff.

kept.excerpt: The Minnesota DFL has endorsed Matt Little, a former state senator and mayor of Lakeville, to replace U.S. Rep. Angie Craig in the 2nd Congressional District. During a congressional district convention on Saturday, Little received 63% of votes, compared to 21% for Rep. Kaela Berg and 14% for Sen. Matt Klein, both of whom plan to push forward with their campaigns.
kept.publisher: Bring Me The News — Brianna Kelly
kept.relevance: Quantifies Little's convention advantage while confirming that both leading opponents intended to continue contesting the primary.

kept.excerpt: Former State Senator Matt Little won the Congressional District 2 DFL endorsement. “Incredibly honored and humbled to receive the endorsement on the first ballot with 63%,” said Matt Little. At congressional district conventions, delegates endorse candidates for Congress.
kept.relevance: Provides a dated official Democratic Party source confirming Little's endorsement and first-ballot delegate support, distinct from winning the August primary nomination.

search_notes: Frozen cutoff: 2026-07-29. All included items have explicit publication dates on or before the cutoff, verified in source-specific web_search results. Excluded later reporting, outcome reports, undated live pages, and prediction-market or betting pages. web_fetch failed because its provider configuration was ambiguous; the requested agent-reach fallback returned a web-channel rate limit, so verification relied on dated search-index article text. The latest included reporting is dated July 28, 2026. The primary poll is explicitly identified as sponsored by Matt Klein; no independent primary poll published closer to the cutoff was verified.
